findings.description: The visible arrow tip is 56px below its intended contact because an absolutely positioned cursor inherited a static position below the menu bar. The title-bar grip is similarly displaced.
findings.correction: Set explicit left:0 and top:0 on #pointer. Assert rendered cursor bounds against the target and window, not just its data coordinates. Recapture and rerender before acceptance.
